_comment: QI Elevation Broker — command whitelist. Only commands matching one of these rules are allowed to execute as SYSTEM. Patterns are regex. Each arg checked independently. Edit requires QI_Elevate service restart.

rules.name: nssm_set_application_cloudflared_tunnel
rules.description: Point a QI_*Tunnel service's executable at the cloudflared binary (named-tunnel migration, added 2026-06-20, authorized by Renne)

rules.name: nssm_set_appparams_cloudflared_named_tunnel
rules.description: AppParameters for a QI_*Tunnel: cloudflared NAMED tunnel run, config under C:\QIH\engine\tunnels\configs (added 2026-06-20)

rules.name: nssm_install_cloudflared_tunnel
rules.description: Install a new QI_*Tunnel service whose app is the cloudflared binary (added 2026-06-20)

rules.name: nssm_install_qi
rules.description: Install a new QI_ NSSM service. App must be python.exe under approved roots; script must be .py under C:\QIH or C:\APPS\QIP.

rules.name: nssm_set_stdout_stderr
rules.description: Set AppStdout or AppStderr log path under C:\QIH or C:\APPS\QIP

rules.name: nssm_set_start_mode
rules.description: Set the Start mode for a QI_ service

rules.name: nssm_set_appdir
rules.description: Repoint a QI_ service AppDirectory under C:\QIH or C:\APPS\QIP

rules.name: nssm_set_appparams
rules.description: Repoint a QI_ service AppParameters under C:\QIH or C:\APPS\QIP

rules.name: nssm_set_appparams_cloudflared_tunnel
rules.description: Set AppParameters for a QI_*Tunnel service to a cloudflared Quick Tunnel invocation (tunnel [--protocol http2|auto|h2mux|quic] --url http://localhost:<port>)

rules.name: nssm_set_application
rules.description: Set the executable for a QI_ service to an approved system binary

rules.name: nssm_set_description
rules.description: Update a QI_ service description string

rules.name: sc_service_control
rules.description: Start/stop/query a QI_ service via sc.exe (fallback path when nssm hits DACL issues)

rules.name: gsudo_cache_control
rules.description: Start or stop the gsudo credentials cache

rules.name: powercfg_hibernate_toggle
rules.description: Toggle Windows hibernation on/off to free/restore hiberfil.sys (added 2026-08-08, authorized by Renne)

rules.name: git_safe_directory_qi
rules.description: Mark a QI repo as safe for git when it is accessed by a service account. QI Hive NSSM services run as LocalSystem while the repos are owned by 'renne', so git refuses every operation with 'detected dubious ownership' — this is what broke the auto-apply pipeline's worktree creation in May 2026. Deliberately scoped to `config --system --add safe.directory <QI path>`: it cannot set any other config key, cannot unset or replace values, and cannot touch paths outside C:/QIH or C:/APPS/QIP. Approved by Renne 2026-08-17. Path segments must begin with an alphanumeric so '..' traversal is impossible.
